If the raw value for a string-valued property is not a string,
warn and discard the value.

-- test.glx --
persons:
    someone:
        properties:
            # name is a string-valued property.
            name: 3

-- want-error --
persons\[someone\].Properties.name: value discarded: expected string, got int
persons\[someone\].Properties.name: entry discarded: has neither value nor fields
persons\[someone\].Properties.name: property discarded: no entries

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
    someone:
        properties: {}
